meta.name: company-intel
meta.description: Research a company, industry, or competitor set using web search and seven analytical lenses. Use when you need structured intel that feeds downstream PM skills.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速摸清公司、行业与竞争对手底细，输出结构化情报
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速了解某家公司或某个赛道的竞争格局
copy.tagline_en: Turn web research into structured company and competitor intelligence
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly understand a company or competitive landscape before decisions

howto.what: 你说出某个公司、某个行业或几个竞争对手后,Claude 会联网搜索,用七个分析视角展开调研,输出带资料来源、可供后续简报/SWOT 等继续使用的结构化报告;点名多家时还会附上各家报告和交叉对比。
howto.when: 当你想研究某个公司、行业或一组竞品并需要结构化情报时触发;请求目标含糊时,它会先确认到底要研究公司、行业还是对手。

say.text: 帮我调研 Helix Motion Systems 的财务状况和产品布局。
say.note: 会按七视角输出带来源的结构化情报。

say.text: 分析一下临床数据管理行业,指出主要趋势。
say.note: 会以行业入口展开分析,并把发现和产品决策联系起来。

say.text: 对比 Figma、Lucidchart 和 Sketch 的竞争定位。
say.note: 会对每个竞品输出一份报告,再做横向对比。

howto.what_en: When asked about a company, an industry, or a competitor set, Claude searches the web, applies seven analytical lenses, and returns a cited structured report; for several rivals it adds per-company reports and a cross-comparison.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for structured research on a specific company, an industry, or a set of competitors. If ambiguous, it first asks which is meant.

say_en.text: Research Helix Motion Systems' financials and product portfolio.
say_en.note: Outputs structured, sourced intel via the seven lenses.

say_en.text: Analyze the clinical data management industry and note major trends.
say_en.note: Runs the industry entry point and links findings to product decisions.

say_en.text: Compare the competitive positioning of Figma, Lucidchart, and Sketch.
say_en.note: Produces one report per competitor and adds a cross-company comparison.
